newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said it has upgraded its recommendation on Brazilian telecommunications firm Telesp to buy from long-term buy and raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings-per-share estimates for the firm.
-- Analysts Paul Aran said in a report that he raised the recommendation due to the company's privatization potential.
-- "Favorable demographics make Telesp's cellular and fixed line assets the most valuable in Brazil," Aran wrote. "This should support a large privatization program."
